_source: Re-based onto environment/nanogpt_substrate.json for batch OER-2026-08-20. Verifier-owned; never assembled onto the agent surface.
statement: The two numbers the bound reward formula is instantiated against are MEASURED IN RUN, by the verifier, through the identical code path that measures the submission. They are not published here and they are not carried across from the retired surrogate. A previous revision of this file pinned 0.292809367 and 0.269349757 as frozen scalars; those numbers described a closed-form function of a shipped sensitivity vector rather than a model, and they are retired rather than repinned.
baseline_recipe: the mean degradation of the uniform allocation at environment/substrate.json uniform_reference_bits, which exactly saturates the frozen budget, measured by real forward passes over the held-out folds
target_recipe: the mean degradation of the reference allocation, fitted by tests/evaluate.py greedy_allocation over per-tensor sensitivity that tests/evaluate.py measured_sensitivity measured on the calibration slice in force, measured over the same folds in the same run
per_point_bar_recipe: the baseline allocation's degradation at each scheduled fold, so the sustained-across-points invariant is held to a bar the harness itself reached at that fold
reference_perplexity_recipe: the pristine checkpoint evaluated unquantized over the same folds in the same run, so both halves of the degradation come from one code path on one corpus
